summary: Recover never-offered stream mail from the preceding seven days, with at most five backlog messages older than one hour per connection, oldest first

replay.detail: Authorized mailbox streams can offer never-offered pre-connection mail within seven days. Recovery mail older than one hour is capped at five per connection; newer mail does not consume the cap. Previously staged, delivered and uncertain native attempts remain held; fencing and delivery holds are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored-format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Legacy polling retains its one-hour pre-boot cutoff; this change applies only to mailbox streams.

manual.detail: No required operator action. The documented unread-latency alert now takes the all-age maximum, including stale mail; external alert rules are not changed.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the stream's one-hour cutoff. Existing receipt and native-attempt history remains authoritative; already offered mail is not replayed.
